Known limitations

  • REST API: In release-candidate soak as part of the 2026-11-09 public flip. Graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-16 — the date alone does not graduate it.
  • Hosted MCP: In release-candidate soak with the public flip; graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-16.
  • Web verifier: Browser submission was broken at the public flip (finding F-AX-10: the API lacked the cross-origin leg for the site origin) and was repaired and re-verified on 2026-11-11.
  • Certificate checker: Browser submission was broken at the public flip (finding F-AX-10) and was repaired and re-verified on 2026-11-11.
  • Ask shell: In release-candidate soak; graduation is a recorded gate decision scheduled for 2026-11-18.
  • Ask explanations: Degraded-first: the explanation step may time out under load. The service facts are still returned and the missing explanation is stated. Explanation latency is an open residual carried in the soak.
  • Billing / credit packs: No purchase path is open. Checkout answers 501 while billing is paused.
  • Paid certificates: Unlock when pack sales open; the trial never produces a certificate.
  • Smart-contract verification: Not a current capability. Nothing on this site presents it as one.
  • Offline / air-gapped verifier: Offline certificate validation IS available today (public CA keys and revocation list). Offline verification is a different capability and is not built.
  • Verified library (complete L2): The verified library is incomplete.
